business_process: Production scheduling and work order release
description: Finite-capacity schedule in the APS for both plants; work orders released from the ERP through the integration platform to the Plant 1 and Plant 2 MES
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Each MES holds about 2 shifts of released work; after 48 hours both plants run out of released work and storm-order slots slip; ERP point-in-time recovery supports a 4-hour RPO
manual_workaround: Printed 5-day schedule per plant refreshed daily; paper travelers from the traveler kit; planners release work by whiteboard
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; SD-WAN provider; ERP software vendor (support)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production planners; shift supervisors at both plants
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,350 work orders a week across both plants; manual release takes about 4 times longer
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Storm-restoration delivery commitments in utility supply agreements

business_process: Plant 1 core cutting and coil winding
description: 4 core cutting lines and 36 winding machines run PLC programs and per-order winding recipes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 1 day of cut cores and wound coils is buffered ahead of assembly; about $836,000 of Plant 1 shipments per production day; recipes change per order so a 24-hour RPO is needed (nightly OT backups)
manual_workaround: Core lines run stored programs locally; manual recipe entry at the winder HMI from printed winding sheets with an engineering double-check
dependent_third_parties: Winding machine and core line OEMs
dependent_people_or_facilities: Winding and core operators; Plant 1 Controls Lead
quantified_operational_impact: About 85 distribution units a day; manual recipe entry cuts winding output by about 40%
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: None beyond supply agreement delivery terms

business_process: Plant 1 drying, tanking, and oil fill
description: 2 vapor-phase drying ovens and the vacuum oil fill line dry insulation and fill every distribution unit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every unit is dried and filled; an interrupted drying cycle must restart; loss of control integrity is a worker safety hazard (heat, vacuum, hot oil); RPO is the last approved recipe and PLC program
manual_workaround: Ovens run stored recipes from the local PLC with the HMI offline; safe shutdown procedure if HMI integrity is in doubt; no manual drying is possible
dependent_systems: SYS-06 (Plant 1 ovens and oil fill); SYS-08 (Plant 1 historian)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Oven operators; Plant 1 Controls Lead; oil processing area
quantified_operational_impact: All Plant 1 output stops after about 1 day; each restarted cycle wastes about 8 hours of oven time
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Severe: heat, vacuum, and hot oil hazards if controls behave unexpectedly

business_process: Plant 1 routine testing and certified test reports
description: Automated routine tests (ratio, resistance, losses, applied and induced voltage) on 8 test stations; Quality signs certified test reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No unit ships without a certified test report; utilities and the federal contracts require them; losing test data means retesting, which takes hours per unit
manual_workaround: Test stations run offline and store results locally; Quality signs reports from raw data printouts; retest where data integrity is in doubt
quantified_operational_impact: About 85 units a day queue for test; shipments held, not lost
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Federal contracts and supply agreements require certified test reports; a report whose data integrity is in doubt cannot be signed
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Moderate: a unit shipped on corrupted test data could fail in service

business_process: Plant 2 core, winding, and core-coil assembly
description: 2 step-lap core cutting lines, 12 vertical winding machines, and assembly bays build power transformers over several weeks each
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Power transformer builds take weeks, so about 2 days of work-in-process buffer exists; about $520,000 of Plant 2 shipments per production day; programs and recipes are copied by hand (RPO is not supported today)
manual_workaround: Manual recipe entry from printed winding specifications with an engineering double-check; cranes run in local mode
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant 2 winders and assemblers; Plant 2 Controls Lead
quantified_operational_impact: About 1 power transformer a day leaves assembly; each lost day pushes about 5 deliveries
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Liquidated damages clauses in about 30% of power transformer contracts

business_process: Plant 2 vapor-phase drying and vacuum oil processing
description: 2 large vapor-phase drying ovens and the vacuum oil processing plant dry and fill each power transformer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A drying cycle for a large unit runs several days and must restart if interrupted; worker safety hazard (heat, vacuum, hot oil); RPO is the last approved recipe and PLC program, which today exists only as a laptop copy
manual_workaround: Ovens run stored recipes from the local PLC; safe shutdown procedure; OEM on call
dependent_systems: SYS-06 (Plant 2 ovens and oil processing); SYS-08 (Plant 2 historian)
dependent_third_parties: Drying oven OEM (through a cellular router today)
quantified_operational_impact: An interrupted cycle wastes up to 3 days of oven time for one unit
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Severe: heat, vacuum, and hot oil hazards

business_process: Plant 2 high-voltage testing and certified test reports
description: Routine and type tests including lightning impulse, applied and induced voltage, and loss measurement on 6 test PCs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No power transformer ships without a certified test report; test bay time is scarce; test data integrity is product integrity; high-voltage safety interlocks must be trusted
manual_workaround: Test systems run offline and store results locally; Quality signs from raw data; retest where integrity is in doubt
dependent_people_or_facilities: Test engineers; Director of Quality; high-voltage test bay
quantified_operational_impact: Each test cycle takes 1 to 2 days per unit; a 2-day stop pushes about 3 deliveries
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Federal contracts and utility specifications require certified tests; witness tests by utilities must be rescheduled
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Severe: high-voltage hazard if test control systems behave unexpectedly

description: CNC plasma cutting and robotic welding cells build tanks and covers at both plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tank shops run about 1 week ahead of assembly; standard tanks can be bought from an outside fabricator
manual_workaround: Manual welding for simple tanks; outside fabricator for standard pad-mount tanks
dependent_third_parties: Welding cell OEM; outside tank fabricator
quantified_operational_impact: Outside fabrication premium about $1,200 per tank

description: Customer specifications, electromagnetic design, drawings, and bills of materials in the PLM vault and CAD workstations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders in production already have released designs; new designs can wait about 3 days; PLM is backed up nightly to the backup account
manual_workaround: Hold new designs; engineers work from released drawings in the traveler kit
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Customer drawings under NDA must be protected during recovery

business_process: TMU configuration, firmware loading, and product software release
description: Load supplier firmware and customer configurations at final test; build, sign, and release the TMU configuration software; answer utility vulnerability and integrity requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Power transformers cannot ship without a configured TMU; addendum duties (hashes, 30-day vulnerability disclosure, incident notice) keep running during an outage
manual_workaround: Verified offline copy of current firmware images and configuration software with supplier and company hashes, held by the VP Engineering
dependent_third_parties: TMU electronics supplier; code repository SaaS
dependent_people_or_facilities: Product software team; Plant 2 final test
quantified_operational_impact: About 1 TMU configured per working day
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Utility addendum secs. 4 and 5 (vulnerability disclosure and integrity) in 31 contracts
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Moderate: a tampered or wrong configuration reaches a utility substation

description: Purchase orders for core steel, copper, oil, bushings, tap changers, and TMUs; receiving; inventory
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Long lead times; about 2 weeks of key stock on hand; ERP point-in-time recovery supports 4 hours
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to the top 20 suppliers; manual receiving log
quantified_operational_impact: About 600 purchase order lines a week

business_process: Shipping, heavy-haul logistics, and export screening
description: Bills of lading, heavy-haul permits and carrier scheduling for power transformers, deliveries to utilities and federal sites, restricted-party screening
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Heavy-haul moves are booked weeks ahead and cost about $25,000 each to rebook; export records must be kept 5 years (15 CFR 762.6(a))
manual_workaround: Paper bills of lading; manual screening through the government consolidated screening list; hold export shipments until the ERP is back
quantified_operational_impact: About 420 distribution units and 5 power transformers ship a week
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Export screening records (C-CRITICAL-MFG-R03); federal delivery schedules

business_process: Field service, storm response, and utility access notices
description: Commissioning, repair, and storm crews; TMU support at utility sites; access-revocation notices owed to utilities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: During storm season utilities rely on crews within a day; addendum duties (1-business-day access notice, 24- or 48-hour incident notice) keep running during an outage
manual_workaround: Phones and printed contact list; field laptops work offline; verified offline TMU software copy
dependent_third_parties: Utilities' remote access systems; TMU electronics supplier
dependent_people_or_facilities: 36 field technicians; Director of Field Service
quantified_operational_impact: Up to 6 storm crews deployed at once
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Utility addendum sec. 3 (1 business day) in 31 contracts
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Moderate: crews on energized equipment depend on accurate work packages

business_process: FMS data ingestion, condition analytics, and customer advisories
description: Receive TMU data pushed by 14 utilities, run AI-003 analytics, review urgent alerts, publish advisories in the customer portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Subscription agreements commit to 99.5% monthly portal availability (about 3.6 hours a month); urgent alerts on gassing transformers lose value within a day; utilities buffer about 72 hours of data on their side
manual_workaround: Reliability engineers call subscribers about known urgent cases from the last advisory list; utilities re-send buffered data after restore
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,150 transformers; about 6 urgent alerts a month
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Service credits under 14 subscription agreements; SOC 2 commitments from 2027
worker_or_product_safety_impact: Moderate: a missed urgent alert could leave a failing utility transformer in service

business_process: Order entry, quoting, and customer service
description: Quotes, orders, change orders, and delivery promises
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders already in backlog are unaffected; new quotes can wait about 3 days
manual_workaround: Quote from the standard price book; email order acknowledgments

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.44 million is invoiced per business day; invoices can wait a few days; payment fraud risk rises during outages
manual_workaround: Manual invoices from shipping records; payments only with call-back verification
quantified_operational_impact: $7.2 million of invoicing delayed at the 120-hour MTD

description: Biweekly payroll, onboarding, terminations, applicant tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly in the payroll SaaS; terminations must still be processed the same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; HR emails IT and Field Service for terminations
quantified_operational_impact: 850 employees paid biweekly; about 20 hires a month
quantified_regulatory_or_contractual_imp: Fla. Stat. 501.171 if employee or applicant data is affected

description: FCI handling, FAR 52.204-25 and -30 reporting, SAM.gov reviews, export classification and screening records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FAR reporting clocks (1 business day under 52.204-25(d); 3 business days under 52.204-23(c) and 52.204-30(c)) run during an outage; records needed for 5 years
manual_workaround: Paper log of identifications and contracting officer contacts; screening through the government website
quantified_operational_impact: 3 federal contracts; about 40 export orders a year
